title: workspace-principals.json
description: Principal classes a plugin supplies (#2524 D5, #3080, ws-079). A package publishes this file as data at its ./workspace-principals subpath, beside ./workspace-kinds. chant reads it with the file system and never imports the package. A class is a name for the principals holding one role in the trust policy at base; the declaration's writeScope may then give it an entry.

$schema.description: An editor hint. chant ignores it.

$comment.description: A note for people. chant ignores it.

name.description: The class's name, as a key of the declaration's writeScope names it. human, agent, runner and service are the core classes and can't be supplied.

description.description: One line saying who is in the class, for listings and error messages.

role.description: The role whose grant in the trust policy at base (.chant/trust.json roles) puts a principal in this class. The agent, runner and service roles belong to the core classes and can't be named here. One role puts a principal in one class.
